target_customer: Companies and communities wanting a private branded community platform
problem: Organizations wanted their own Bookface style community space with discussion and chat instead of stitching together forums and Slack.
business_model: SaaS subscription for white label community hosting (pricing not found)

founders.name: Rishab Hegde
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page. Background not found.

exit.reason: Founder said he had to wind it down and later open sourced it; his explanation was not retrieved

technical_complexity.rationale: Threaded discussion, chat, directories and moderation are standard web features that one developer could build, though real time chat adds some work.

defensibility.rationale: Community software with many alternatives and no data or network moat across customers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The shutdown notice on comradery.com recommends Circle as a hosted alternative, which suggests the space stayed crowded.

market_need_then: No dated source found on demand. The YC pitch rested on Bookface being valued by YC founders.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch in March 2020 ranked fourth of the day and a 2021 open source relaunch, 13 reviews rated 4.1

brand_strength.rationale: Product Hunt traction exists but no source shows brand driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Comradery was a one person white label community platform from W19. The founder wound it down around early 2021 and then released the code as open source, but the reason he gave was not retrievable, so the cause is not public in the sources found. The site itself now says the service is no longer running and points users to Circle.
notes: No funding information found in two searches. Competitor search returned nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Product Hunt similar products (Discourse, Circle) are not dated near 2019 so are excluded. The Product Hunt launch dates (March 2020, March 2021) are listed on the page; the shutdown timing is inferred only from the maker saying he wound down a few months before the 2021 open source post.
